data.name: Section 7
data.detailed_description:
"In 1947, a classified annex to Title 50, Section 31 of the United States Code was quietly ratified.

It acknowledged a truth the public would never know: Earth was not alone, and not all visitors come in peace.

It authorized a permanent, off-the-books division with one mandate: identify, contain, and eliminate extraterrestrial threats.

They called it Section 7.

These are their cases."

Where the paranormal is your jurisdiction! In this cooperative, turn-based tactical combat game, you and up to three friends will become elite agents of a clandestine government division tasked with investigating the unexplainable. Experience the strategic depth of a digital tabletop game blended with the thrilling mystery of supernatural investigations.

Gather your squad, choose from 6 distinct agents, each bringing unique expertise, starting decks, and abilities to the field. Roll the dice, play tactical cards, and position your agents carefully on the grid to outsmart entities that defy natural law.

Forget standard dungeons. In Section 7, you deploy into multi-stage campaigns in the form of Cases. Each case is comprised of a number of levels, all set in different areas of the world, with their own flavor and challenge, and their own unique set of enemies. Each level features dynamic objectives and procedurally generated layouts, ensuring no two investigations ever unfold exactly the same way!

The game can be played by 1 to 4 players, each controlling one agent (or more!) and taking turns simultaneously. Gone is the day of having to wait for your turn; in Section 7 you have the freedom to take your action whenever you want in the players' round! This allows you to strategize the ultimate play, without having to rely on turn order!

Between stages, the narrative deepens. Review classified briefings and thematic descriptions of the case's unfolding events to piece together the mystery. Draft powerful new equipment and ability cards to upgrade your deck, adapt to the escalating threat, and prepare your agents for the unknown horrors awaiting in the next location.

  • Tactical Tabletop Combat: Master a deep, turn-based combat system driven by strategic card play, grid positioning, and dice rolls.

  • 1-4 Player Co-op: Investigate solo and control the whole team, or form a squad with friends online to coordinate your tactics.

  • 6 Unique Agents: Build your perfect team from a roster of specialized operatives, each with distinct playstyles and synergistic abilities.

  • 4 Full Campaign Cases at Launch: Dive into gripping, multi-stage investigations, each featuring their own unique enemies, environments, and mysteries to solve.

  • Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated levels, varied objectives, and dynamic card drafting ensure every case remains unpredictable, no matter how many times you open the file.

data.short_description: Join Section 7, a classified division tasked with hunting extraterrestrial threats. In this 1-4 player co-op turn-based tactical RPG, you'll roll dice, play cards, and navigate a digital tabletop to investigate cases. Build your deck, position your agents, and uncover the truth.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent fantasy/sci-fi violence and paranormal horror themes suitable for a mature audience.

Violence: Players control a squad of special agents engaged in turn-based tactical combat against hostile paranormal entities, mutated creatures, and hostile human cultists. Combat involves the use of firearms, melee weapons, and special abilities. Enemies react with hit impacts and defeat animations, but there is no graphic gore, dismemberment, or prolonged depiction of injury. Violence is presented in a stylized tabletop/miniature aesthetic.

Thematic Elements: The story involves conspiracy theories, secret government operations, and cosmic horror. It deals with themes of paranoia, betrayal, and the ethical dilemmas of containing dangerous supernatural phenomena. There are no depictions of sexual assault, self-harm, or drug abuse. Alcohol and drug references are limited to optional character background flavor text (e.g., a retired agent's history) and are not depicted or glorified in-game.
